Name: Genuine cross-frequency coupling networks in human resting-state electrophysiological recordings (Siebenhuehner et al., 2020): SEEG and MEG connectomes (derivative)

GeneratedBy.Name: Authors' analysis pipeline (Siebenhühner et al., 2020, PLoS Biol 18(5):e3000685, Methods)
GeneratedBy.Description: 10-min eyes-closed resting-state SEEG (59 patients, Niguarda Hospital, Milan; 1000 Hz; closest-white-matter referencing; exclusion of epileptic-zone and subcortical contacts and of interictal-event windows; Morlet wavelets m=5, 49 frequencies 1.2-315 Hz) and 10-min eyes-open resting-state MEG (19 healthy participants, 27 sets; 306-channel Elekta/MEGIN; tSSS, ICA; MNE source modelling collapsed to 200 split-Destrieux parcels with fidelity weighting; Morlet m=5, 1.1-315 Hz), plus a second MEG cohort (10 participants, eyes open/closed, 148 Destrieux parcels). Per subject and frequency (pair): phase synchrony (PLV, wPLI), cross-frequency phase synchrony (CFS), phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) and amplitude-envelope coupling, each with surrogate values; exported as CSV matrices. Code: https://github.com/palvalab/Resting_State_CFC
